description: This file contains a C program that generates a firmware command line by reading an input file, processing command-line options, and writing output to a specified file. It includes functions for parsing options, emitting load instructions, and the main function orchestrating the process.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Prints error message and usage instructions, then exits.

methods.name: parseopts
methods.description: Parses command-line options for input/output files and load address.

methods.name: emitload
methods.description: Emits a load instruction to the output file for a specific register and value.
